What's New in 6.1.2

Highlights

  • OpenCode in the Quota Meter shows the session you are in. Each OpenCode terminal shows its open conversation by its real title, working or idle, and closed conversations no longer pose as live. Setup is automatic: a small plugin, with its status in Settings → OpenCode. OpenCode Desktop shows working sessions only, since it keeps its idle selection to itself.

Improvements

  • Old sessions keep the price they were run at. A provider price change now applies only to usage after it. Gemini 3.6 and 3.8 Flash double on January 1, 2027; your 2026 sessions keep their 2026 cost.

Bug Fixes

  • Codex limits come back after a connection drop. A network failure could leave Codex quota out of date for up to an hour. Now it rechecks within a minute, and a warning with Retry replaces the old percentage.
  • Cleaner startup. The app no longer shows two "Select a session" prompts at once, or "Ready" while sessions are still indexing.

Reminder: What You Got in 6.1

  • OpenCode in the Quota Meter. Running OpenCode sessions now appear under the OpenCode logo, below Codex and Claude, each marked working or idle. Limits and burn rate are not there yet. OpenCode Go users who want to help add them: open an issue.
  • Quota Meter in the notch (new in 6.0). Codex and Claude limits sit beside the MacBook camera, or in a small virtual notch on other displays. Hover to open the full meter with live session burn. Pick Notch, Desktop or Automatic in Settings.
  • OpenCode 2.x sessions (new in 6.0). Sessions from OpenCode 2.0 and later reach the list, and sessions carried over from 1.x keep their full history.
  • Every agent's latest format (new in 6.0.1). Fresh sessions from twelve agents, Codex 0.163 and Claude Code 2.1.306 among them, read cleanly. OpenClaw 2026.10.5 and DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1 sessions are back, Antigravity desktop and Cline Desktop sessions appear, fx 0.0.8 sessions open, and Claude transcripts no longer repeat each turn.

Full release notes: https://github.com/jazzyalex/agent-sessions/releases/tag/v6.1.2
